loader_kwargs.proposal_topic_intro:
Voice-enabled interfaces in embedded and wearable devices must meet tight energy budgets while maintaining robust speaker recognition and diarisation quality. Neuromorphic computing via spiking neural networks offers an energy-efficient alternative to conventional deep-learning inference engines.

Combining RL-based policy adaptation---exemplified by the LoopSR lifelong framework---with AdaFire spiking neurons and World Model-based Perception creates a pipeline that can adapt to distribution shifts (new speakers, acoustic environments) without full retraining.

Speaker diarisation metrics and blockchain-authenticated voice data provide the evaluation and trust layers. The three PIs hold unpublished results directly relevant to each component: diarisation and RL (Alpha), multi-agent RL coordination (Beta), and SNN modelling with RL integration (Gamma).

The 5Q proposal should establish the target hardware platform, the joint training objective, and the evaluation benchmarks for diarisation accuracy vs. energy per inference.
loader_kwargs.proposal_topic_title: Neuromorphic RL for Low-Power Voice Interfaces
